Remote Select ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Load asynchronous options in a select with reload and cancellation.

Basic usage ​

The example loads options through a local Promise-based function and demonstrates model updates, pausing, and reloading. Requests run entirely within the demo.

Click the current-label control to read the instance's read-only selectedLabel. An empty single model returns an empty string. A selection returns the current label. See the full notes.

Example: basic

vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="multipleMode">启用多选</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteSelect
			v-if="!multipleMode"
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:data-source="dataSource"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelect>
		<AsamRemoteSelect
			v-else
			ref="control"
			v-model="multipleValue"
			multiple
			:data-source="dataSource"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelect>
		<div class="demo-actions">
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				:disabled="!active || reloading"
				@click="reload"
			>
				强制重载
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				:disabled="!reloading"
				@click="control?.cancel()"
			>
				取消请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readSelectedLabel">
				读取当前标签
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.focus()">
				聚焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@mousedown.prevent
				@click="control?.blur()"
			>
				失焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ multipleMode ? multipleValue : value }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="selected-label">{{ selectedLabel }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectBasicExample' });
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelect, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamApiRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Item {
	label: string;
	value: string;
	children?: readonly Item[];
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const active = ref(true);
const multipleMode = ref(false);
const multipleValue = ref<string[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, Item>>();
const selectedLabel = ref<string | string[]>('');
function readSelectedLabel() {
	selectedLabel.value = control.value?.selectedLabel ?? '';
}
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const reloading = ref(false);
const items: readonly Item[] = [
	{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
	{ label: '进行', value: 'running' },
	{ label: '待复核', value: 'review' },
	{ label: '已完成', value: 'done' }
];
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(context.signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, 900);
		context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
const dataSource = factory.api({
	api,
	params: { text: '' },
	transform: (response) => response,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
async function reload() {
	reloading.value = true;
	result.value = '加载中';
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		reloading.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.data-demo {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}
.data-demo > p,
.data-demo > pre,
.data-demo > fieldset {

	margin: 0;
}

}
</style>

	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

Local creation and complete option objects ​

With allow-create and filterable enabled, createOption(text) synchronously returns a complete AsamOption<V, I> with a label, correctly typed value, and actual raw record. See the full notes.

Example: local-creation

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-layout-1">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.clearCreatedOptions()">
				清空本地创建集合
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="value = null">
				清空模型
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="tenant = tenant === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a'"
			>
				切换逻辑来源
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="canonical">来源接受 Omega 同值项</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamRemoteSelect
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:api="api"
			:params="{ tenant, text: '' }"
			:transform="transform"
			:search="search"
			:create-option="createOption"
			value-mode="object"
			allow-create
			filterable
			clearable
			size="default"
			placeholder="输入 Omega 并选择创建项"
			@success="providerValues = $event.map((item) => item.value)"
			@error="message = $event.message"
		>
			<template #header><p class="example-paragraph">本地创建和来源选项分别保存</p></template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="example-paragraph">刷新保留本地项，逻辑来源改变时清空本地集合</p>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteSelect>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ message }}</p>
		<pre>模型：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre>工厂调用：{{ JSON.stringify(createdTexts) }}</pre>
		<pre>provider success 值：{{ JSON.stringify(providerValues) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamOption,
	AsamCreateOption,
	AsamValue,
	AsamAsyncSelectExpose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	tenant: string;
	text: string;
}
const tenant = ref('a');
const failure = ref(false);
const canonical = ref(false);
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectLocalCreationDemo' });
const value = ref<AsamOption<string, Member> | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, Member>>();
const createdTexts = ref<string[]>([]);
const providerValues = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const createOption: AsamCreateOption<string, Member> = (text) => {
	createdTexts.value.push(text);
	return { label: text, value: text, raw: { id: 'local-' + text, label: text, value: text } };
};
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示请求失败');
	const items: Member[] = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
	if (canonical.value) items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.text.toLowerCase()));
};
const search = {
	debounceMs: 100,
	buildParams: (params: Query, text: string) => ({ ...params, text })
};
async function reload() {
	await nextTick();
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (result.value === 'success') message.value = '';
}
</script>

The local collection belongs to the current component. The provider, cache, and success payload contain source options. Options with the same type and value are deduplicated, with the provider's canonical option taking precedence. Refreshing keeps the object already assigned to the parent model. Clearing and then selecting again uses the current canonical source option.

clearCreatedOptions() clears local options and the text memo and preserves v-model. Search within the same source, reload, ordinary epoch changes, and retry after failure retain local options. Changes in actual source, base params, field policy, or provider or scope clear them. Update v-model separately to clear the model.

Data sources and overrides ​

Provide exactly one source: dataSource, api with params, or request. See the full notes.

Single selection uses a scalar or null in value mode and a normalized AsamOption in object mode. For multiple selections, combine multiple, valueMode, and multipleValueMode to choose an array or a delimited string. Object mode requires an array. Update the model type when changing the value strategy.

The source manages options, loading, and remote queries. This data component uses ASAM value and object modes. Apply the base component features that fit the selected data mode.

Lifecycle, events, and instance methods ​

active=false pauses requests and retains the last successful data. Use reload({ force: true }) for fresh data and cancel() to cancel the current request. See the full notes.

immediate controls the initial request, and active controls whether requests are enabled. See the generated API for the defaults and their sources.

Slots and base features ​

prefix, header, footer, empty, loading, tag, and label keep their base scopes. selectedLabel is read-only, and focus() and blur() control input focus. The virtual select's default slot uses the base virtual option scope.

Related base components ​

  • Select provides the applicable display, interaction, and public API.

Use this page's rules for data sources, models, events, and exposed members, and refer to the linked base components for the features available here. Sizes follow the ASAM base components. Examples use default.

URL provider and shared request lifecycle ​

The complete example creates an isolated child app and installs its local provider with provideAsamData before mount. The demonstration URL receives no network traffic. See the full notes.

setAsamDataScope() invalidates requests from the old scope and triggers a reload. invalidateAsamData() advances the current epoch. See the full notes.

Example: provider-lifetime

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="verifyAppContracts">
			检查应用安装与 scope 边界
		</AsamButton>
		<pre data-testid="provider-app-contract">{{ JSON.stringify(checks) }}</pre>
		<div ref="host" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="verifyRuntimeKey">
			检查公开 runtime 注入键
		</AsamButton>
		<pre data-testid="runtime-key-contract-result">{{ JSON.stringify(runtimeKeyResult) }}</pre>
		<div ref="runtimeKeyHostA" />
		<div ref="runtimeKeyHostB" />
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectProviderLifetimeDemo' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	provideAsamData,
	getAsamDataRuntime,
	setAsamDataScope,
	AsamDataFailure
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createProvider } from './provider';
import type { ProviderState } from './provider';

const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
let installedProvider: AsamDataProvider | undefined;
let providerState: ProviderState | undefined;
const checks = ref<object | null>(null);
function rejected(operation: () => void): string {
	try {
		operation();
		return 'accepted';
	} catch (cause) {
		if (!(cause instanceof AsamDataFailure)) throw cause;
		return cause.kind;
	}
}
function verifyAppContracts() {
	if (!app || !installedProvider || !providerState) return;
	const target = app;
	const provider = installedProvider;
	const runtime = getAsamDataRuntime(target);
	const before = {
		calls: providerState.calls.length,
		scope: runtime.scope,
		epoch: runtime.epoch
	};
	provideAsamData(target, provider);
	const sameRuntime = runtime === getAsamDataRuntime(target);
	const replacement = rejected(() => provideAsamData(target, {}));
	// This scenario deliberately creates an independent app to verify runtime isolation.
	// eslint-disable-next-line vue/one-component-per-file
	const other = createApp({ render: () => null });
	const otherRuntime = getAsamDataRuntime(other);
	const context = runtime.createContext();

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export interface ProviderCall {
	readonly text: string;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly epoch: number;
	readonly requestId: number;
}
export interface ProviderState {
	failure: boolean;
	slow: boolean;
	calls: ProviderCall[];
	aborts: number;
}

/** Local transport only: no server URL is contacted by this example. */
export function createProvider() {
	const state = reactive<ProviderState>({ failure: false, slow: false, calls: [], aborts: 0 });
	let release: () => void = () => undefined;
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		async request(config, context) {
			if (config.url !== '/demo/members' || config.method !== 'get')
				throw new Error('Unknown local route');
			const text = config.params?.text;
			if (typeof text !== 'string') throw new Error('text must be a string');
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			state.calls.push({
				text,
				scope: context.scope,
				epoch: context.epoch,
				requestId: context.requestId
			});
			if (state.slow) {
				await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
					const abort = () => {
						state.aborts++;
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						reject(context.signal.reason);
					};
					context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
					release = () => {
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						resolve();
					};
				});
			}
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			if (state.failure) throw new Error('Local provider failure');
			return [
				{ id: 1, name: '第一成员' },
				{ id: 2, name: '第二成员' }
			].filter((item) => item.name.includes(text));
		}
	};
	return { provider, state, release: () => release() };
}

				throw new Error('Unknown local route');
			const text = config.params?.text;
			if (typeof text !== 'string') throw new Error('text must be a string');
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			state.calls.push({
				text,
				scope: context.scope,
				epoch: context.epoch,
				requestId: context.requestId
			});
			if (state.slow) {
				await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
					const abort = () => {
						state.aborts++;
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						reject(context.signal.reason);
					};
					context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
					release = () => {
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
						resolve();
					};
				});
			}
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			if (state.failure) throw new Error('Local provider failure');
			return [
				{ id: 1, name: '第一成员' },
				{ id: 2, name: '第二成员' }
			].filter((item) => item.name.includes(text));
		}
	};
	return { provider, state, release: () => release() };
}

Installing the same provider again on one app preserves its runtime. Installing a different provider on that app throws a config error. See the full notes.

Complete option and tag presentation ​

Two independent instances show OptionGroup and Option grouped by source raw.team, prefix, header, footer, loading, empty, label, and removable tags. See the full notes.

Use the demo controls to toggle tag collapsing, switch the visible count between 1 and 3, and set the selection limit to 3 or 0 for unlimited. Presentation changes preserve the source and model. Remove the limit to select a fourth item. The reset control sets the model to [1, 3, 4] and restores the limit. Removing a tag through the control instead emits remove-tag.

The presentation example records update:modelValue and change for a raw number in single mode and a raw array in multiple mode, plus success with the full normalized options. Trigger a refresh failure to inspect error.kind and error.message and see the previous selection retained, then recover. Cancelling a held request emits no additional success. Each log entry stores a separate payload snapshot.

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectNativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import type { StyleValue } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamRemoteSelect,
	defineAsamOptions,
	AsamOption,
	AsamOptionGroup
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamSelectDataEmits,
	AsamValue,
	AsamDataError,
	AsamOption as DataOption,
	AsamAsyncSelectExpose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState, Member } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectNativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject<DemoState>('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state: DemoState = injected;
const singleControl = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<number, Member>>();
const singleValue = ref<number | null>(null);
type DataEmits = AsamSelectDataEmits<AsamValue, object>;
const dataEvents = ref<
	readonly {
		readonly mode: 'single' | 'multiple';
		readonly name: string;
		readonly payload: unknown;
	}[]
>([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode: 'single' | 'multiple', name: string, payload: unknown) {
	const snapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload: DataEmits['update:modelValue'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload: DataEmits['change'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload: DataEmits['success'][0]) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload: AsamDataError) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref<readonly number[]>([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const popperStyleMode = ref<'object' | 'string' | 'array' | 'false' | 'null' | 'undefined'>(
	'object'
);
const popperStyle = computed<StyleValue>(() => {
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'object') return { minWidth: '320px' };
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'string') return 'min-width: 360px';
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'array') return [{ minWidth: '400px' }, [{ maxWidth: '460px' }]];
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref<readonly DataOption<number, Member>[]>([]);
const groups = computed(() =>
	['一组', '二组'].map((team) => ({
		team,
		options: singleOptions.value.filter((item) => item.raw.team === team)
	}))
);
const api: AsamApiRequest<{ text: string }, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) =>
	state.read(context.signal, params.text);
const factory = defineAsamOptions<number, Member>();
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const source = factory.api({
	api,
	params: { text: '' },
	transform,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value', disabled: 'disabled' }
});
function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number;
	readonly id: number;
	readonly team: string;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
}
const rows: readonly Member[] = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	async function read(signal: AbortSignal, text: string) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

import { ref } from 'vue';
const rows = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set();
	async function read(signal, text) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export function createDemoProvider(state) {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

Public runtime injection key ​

Use the public asamDataRuntimeKey in Vue setup to inject the current app's runtime. See the full notes.

The independent apps demonstrate provider and runtime scope isolation and lifecycle. See the full notes.

Public type of the creation callback ​

AsamCreateOption<V, I> takes one required string and directly returns AsamOption<V, I>. See the full notes.

Type checking rejects asynchronous factories, scalar results, missing raw, incompatible label, value, or raw, children with different generics, and non-string input. See the full notes.

The complete TypeScript and JavaScript local-creation examples call the factory through real typing and option selection. Observe reuse of the same text, retention after refresh and failure, changes of logical source, precedence of a matching server option, and a new factory call after clearing the local set. The source owns its results and the parent owns the model. The factory runs locally without a server creation request.

Value policies and selection model types ​

The value policy distinguishes single selection, multiple selection of values, and multiple selection of objects. Configure storage for the chosen branch. See the full notes.

Policy Model type Empty selection
Single value V or null null
Single object AsamOption<V, I> or null null
Multiple value / array readonly V[] []
Multiple value / string string Empty string
Multiple object / array readonly AsamOption<V, I>[] []

Policy props and selection arrays are read-only. See the full notes.

basic demonstrates single value selection, local-creation demonstrates a complete single object, and native-presentation demonstrates a multiple-selection value array. See the full notes.

Internal source descriptors ​

Use defineAsamOptions, defineAsamDictSource, and resolveAsamOptions to create and consume sources. See the full notes.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only when the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. See the full notes.

Call retry() without arguments. It returns the forced reload Promise and follows the same cancellation and unmount behavior. See the full notes.

Providing the slot replaces the default local error region, including when the slot renders empty content. With the slot omitted, the component displays its error message, stale-data hint, and retry button. The slot requires a current error. empty, loading, and other base slots keep their original scopes.

In the complete TypeScript and JavaScript example, trigger a failure and await the slot's retry() result. After a success, trigger a refresh failure to see the existing result and model retained. Each mount creates an isolated child app with a local provider.

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelect, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamAsyncSelectSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, object>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>().api({
	api: transport.api,
	params: undefined,
	transform: (rows) => rows,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamAsyncSelectSlots<string, object>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;

}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;

		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

Local and global poppers ​

The basic example uses default global mounting. The local mounting example explicitly configures teleported or appendTo. Open the popper and inspect its container. Mount location is independent of the model and request protocol.

Additional usage notes ​

Basic usage ​

Click the current-label control to read the instance's read-only selectedLabel. An empty single model returns an empty string, and a selection returns its label. Call focus() and blur() without arguments to control input focus independently of the model. The blur button prevents its mouse-down action from taking focus so you can observe blur() itself. Enable multiple selection to use an independent array model. The label result is an empty array when nothing is selected and a label array after selection. The focus methods leave both models untouched.

Local creation and complete option objects ​

With allow-create and filterable enabled, createOption(text) synchronously returns a complete AsamOption<V, I> with a label, correctly typed value, and actual raw. The default generates a string. For numbers, booleans, or custom raw, supply a type-matched synchronous factory returning the complete record.

Data sources and overrides ​

Provide exactly one source: dataSource, api with params, or request. Create a dataSource with defineAsamOptions and configure mapping, transformation, and caching inside the factory. Use the top-level shorthand props only for the shorthand branches. Custom field mapping requires a synchronous transform. The API returns a Promise and checks context.signal.

Lifecycle, events, and instance methods ​

active=false pauses requests and retains the last successful data. Use reload({ force: true }) for fresh data and cancel() to cancel the current request. success emits a normalized option array. error emits an AsamDataError. A failed refresh marks the last successful data stale. Handle the reload result by its status of success, error, or cancelled.

URL provider and shared request lifecycle ​

The example installs a local provider with provideAsamData in an isolated child app before mount. The example URL stays local to the scenario. Two components with the same source, params, field mapping, transform, scope, and epoch can share the underlying transport with ttlMs caching enabled. The provider executes request. GET is the default and leaves params and data in their configured places. transform validates the original response and produces Member records. fieldNames maps name and id to label and value. Provider errors take the error path. A failed refresh keeps previous data and marks it stale, then successful recovery clears the flag. The cache holds normalized successful source records. Component models and local options are kept separately.

URL provider and shared request lifecycle ​

setAsamDataScope() invalidates requests for the old scope and reloads. invalidateAsamData() advances the current epoch. The runtime passes context.signal, scope, epoch, and requestId to the provider. Discard late results associated with an old context. During a shared forced reload, cancelling one component's subscription promptly resolves that subscriber as cancelled. Other subscribers keep the underlying transfer alive until it completes, everyone cancels, or the app unmounts. The parent controls its own model across scope changes. Handle AsamReloadResult by its success, error, or cancelled branch.

URL provider and shared request lifecycle ​

Reinstalling the same provider on one app returns its existing runtime. Installing a different provider throws a config error. Each app has its own runtime, provider, and contexts. The controls verify that the same scope preserves the epoch and request, and that empty and whitespace-only scopes are rejected without changing the model, source, or epoch. getAsamDataRuntime(app) returns the same coordinator for that app. createContext() creates a current context. release(context) releases and cancels it. A context only belongs to its own runtime. invalidateAsamData() always advances the epoch, while setAsamDataScope() does so only when switching to a different valid scope.

Complete option and tag presentation ​

Two independent instances show OptionGroup and Option grouped by raw.team, prefix, header, footer, loading, empty, label, and removable tags. The source returns flat normalized entries. Grouping organizes native options in the default slot and preserves the source and model. Multiple selection uses a raw number array and keeps collapsed-tag tooltips, maxCollapseTags, multipleLimit, and disabled. Custom tags call native deleteTag to emit remove-tag. The completion button releases a local pending operation to show the actual loading and empty slots. Unmounting the isolated child app cancels the request. The standard select sets a 320px popper minimum with popperStyle.minWidth.

Complete option and tag presentation ​

The collapsed-tag tooltip toggles independently of the count and model. The popper style controls demonstrate StyleValue as an object, string, nested array, and cleared with false, null, or undefined. The demo uses minimum widths of 320, 360, and 400px and restores the native width after clearing. Presentation changes preserve the current source result. Returning from the array style to the object removes the previous maxWidth.

Public type of the creation callback ​

AsamCreateOption<V, I> takes one required string and returns AsamOption<V, I> directly. With no generics supplied, V is the union of string, number, and boolean, and I is a read-only AsamRecord with unknown field values. The select's default factory produces string values. A custom factory must return the complete numeric or boolean value, business raw, and any recursive children with the same V and I types. The option's public properties are read-only. Nested raw objects are not guaranteed to be deeply frozen by the type.

Public type of the creation callback ​

Type checking rejects asynchronous factories, scalar returns, missing raw, incompatible label, value, or raw, child options using different generics, and non-string input. The number type includes NaN and Infinity, and the runtime separately requires finite values, an object for raw, boolean disabled, and complete, acyclic children. The synchronous callback guard rejects promises and thenables. Invalid options are rejected before insertion into the local set. Business-specific rules for raw belong to the application.

Value policies and selection model types ​

Policy props and selection arrays are read-only. Object mode uses a normalized record with label, value, and raw. Delimited storage is typed as string, with runtime checks for delimiters, token validity, and option matching. Runtime normalization rejects invalid policies, string storage for multiple objects, empty separators, and source values that contain the separator, serialize to an empty token, or collide upon serialization. TypeScript's structural types may accept extra fields. The runtime checks a single-selection input for an unsupported multipleValueMode.

Value policies and selection model types ​

basic and local-creation show single values and complete single objects respectively, and native-presentation shows multiple values as an array. The Remote Checkbox Group basic example shows a delimited string with two separator choices and an empty string. Its connected-buttons example shows an array of objects. Remote Radio Group shows a scalar and a complete object. Update the model before changing the policy or separator so its representation matches the new configuration.

Internal source descriptors ​

Use defineAsamOptions, defineAsamDictSource, and resolveAsamOptions to create and consume sources. The package root's export type * makes the describeAsamOptionsSource declaration available for type queries using import type and typeof. The reader is internal and has no callable root or supported deep export. Real factories register their descriptors, and copying { kind } does not create a valid source.

Local request error slot ​

The optional error slot runs only while the current request has an error. It receives a read-only { error, stale, retry } scope. The error is the same AsamDataError emitted by that instance, including cause, kind, message, and notified. Rendering the slot leaves the provider's notification state unchanged. stale indicates that the retained data is outdated.

Additional props and events ​

Public runtime injection key ​

asamDataRuntimeKey is the package root's public InjectionKey<AsamDataRuntime>. Use inject() in Vue setup and handle undefined when no runtime is provided. getAsamDataRuntime(app) and provideAsamData(app, provider) use the same key, preserve runtime identity within one app, and give separate apps their own runtimes and providers. Injection keys compare by identity. Import the shared key to resolve the runtime.

Public runtime injection key ​

The TypeScript and JavaScript provider-lifetime examples mount two actual apps and inject through the public key. Check their distinct scopes and providers, absent lookups through a different symbol or string, scope changes confined to one app, and cleanup of a manually created context on unmount. Direct injection supplies the runtime object. A component that creates a context also releases it. runtime.scope is a getter.

Value policies and selection model types ​

AsamValuePolicy has three branches. Single selection uses value or object as its valueMode. Multiple value selection supports array or string as its multipleValueMode. Multiple object selection uses array. AsamSelection<V, I, M> is the conditional type for the model selected by policy M. It operates at type level and doesn't convert runtime values or link component props to the model.

Local request error slot ​

Call retry() without arguments. It returns the Promise from reload({ force: true }) with the success, error, or cancelled branch of AsamReloadResult<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>. Retrying follows active, the current source, cancellation, and unmount, and preserves the model.
